up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules described in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5241111'. The query should link the document to its associated compounds and their structural data. Return exactly the columns: chembl_id, pref_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Do not apply any limits or ranking.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5241111'
